items.title: Is ExxonMobil Holdings (XOM) Undervalued After Its $12.5b Guyana Longtail Approval?
items.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings (XOM) just approved a US$12.5b Longtail development offshore Guyana, targeting non associated gas and condensate. This gives investors a fresh long term project to factor into the stock’s risk profile. The Longtail decision comes at a time when ExxonMobil Holdings’ share price has been strong, with a year to date share price return of 39.09% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 45.87% backed by dividends.
